byzantium.name: Eastern Roman Empire
byzantium.description: An alternate-history eastern Roman restoration around Constantinople, Greece and Cyprus. Any eligible founder may retain its political institutions; ownership, peace, stability and the founding cost are still required.

western_roman_empire.name: Western Roman Empire
western_roman_empire.description: An alternate-history western Roman restoration joining Italy, France, Spain and Tunisia. Consolidate the declared territories by control, loyal subjects or consenting accession partners. Proclamation never grants unowned land.

roman_restoration.description: A unified alternate-history Roman restoration across both Mediterranean cores: Italy, France, Spain, Greece, Turkey, Cyprus and Tunisia. Eastern or Western Roman foundations may progress to this state; each required territory must be secured or join by consent.
